question: The Abhinandan Saroja National Award 2021 was conferred on which of the following dancers?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Aparna Satheesan__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Abhinandan Saroja National Award was begun on the birthday of the legendary Guru Smt. Padma Bhushan Saroja Vaidyanathan for commending the heritage in the field of Indian Classical Dance.
 
• Aparna Satheesan Receiver of the 2021 Abhinandan Saroja National Award by the National Institute of Indian Classical Dance. 
 
• Aparna Satheesan is an internationally praised skillful dancer who instructed in various classical Indian dance forms such as** Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi, Mohiniyattom, Kathakali, Ottam Thullal**, etc.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Yamini Reddy** is a renowned **Kuchipudi dancer,** educator, choreographer, and Director of Natya Tarangini, a school committed to providing Kuchipudi instruction. She has performed extensively both in India and internationally.
 
• **Rama Vaidyanathan** is a world-renowned Indian **Bharatanatyam **artist based in Delhi. She is married to C. V. Kamesh, CXO at Hitachi India, and is the daughter-in-law of Saroja Vaidyanathan. Additionally, she serves as one of the directors of Ganesha Natyalaya, one of the best Bharatanatyam institutes in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/480b4b30a38e7c33e352e3a706caa2cb0a639b7c46fdb0a3ae9b98eb200fbacd.png]
